accepted_obligation: Prime-field root tests, canonical representation, inversion, one common quadratic witness field, and complete bit-cost specialization of the accepted selected-subsystem solver
algorithm_unchanged: Rank-two spanning forest, degree-at-most-two component domains, canonical-label sorting, sequential at-most-one 2SAT and all-false repair
extraction: Separate SAME-MODEL S_B^bit + O((N+1)*ell+b+M*E_B^bit+M*b^2); combined S_B^bit+O(M*E_B^bit)+D plus witness surcharge. Scalar S_B/E_B cannot substitute.
nonsquare_discovery: Not needed for decision. Odd-p witness without supplied eta costs expected Las Vegas O(b^3), or explicit deterministic O(p*b^3) scan surcharge.
not_claimed: All closure solutions have degree at most two
Any external publication or native state change
output: Nonzero coordinate pairs; O(N*b) row payload and O((N+1)*b) total including field descriptor and decision bit. Canonical normalized output adds O(N*b^3).
promises: Prime p or separately charged primality validation
Canonical b-bit residues or separately charged input reading/reduction
Specified record-random-access bit model with charged record indices and payloads
quantifier: Every selected system with F_p input feasible over the algebraic closure has at least one solution in one common F_(p^2). Not every particular algebraic-closure solution lies in that field.
remain_open: Concrete target preparation and extraction bit costs
Legal Green parameters, weights and denominators
s: v2(p-1) for odd p; s=0 at p=2 in the displayed uniform bound
storage: O((N+M+1)*(b+ell)) bits beyond retained target oracle
witness: D + O(b^3+W*(b^3+s^2*b^2)); W<=min(N,M); odd-p supplied eta certified; p=2 no eta and O(1+W) setup/root work
